confirmed_findings.title: Public chart route returns 404 for mobile user-agents
confirmed_findings.interpretation: The route failure follows the mobile user-agent independently of viewport width, isolating user-agent routing rather than responsive layout as the dominant cause.

passed_checks.title: Trusted UI transition from daily to hourly candles

signals_requiring_follow_up.title: Desktop chart first became visibly renderable after approximately 7.48 seconds
signals_requiring_follow_up.next_experiment: Repeat three cold runs and separate document/runtime/history-response/canvas-render timing.

signals_requiring_follow_up.title: Console emitted 'ERROR: No context for render' while the chart remained visible
signals_requiring_follow_up.next_experiment: Correlate the message with specific canvas layers, resize events, multi-chart layout and timeframe transitions.

signals_requiring_follow_up.title: Narrow viewport with desktop user-agent exposes toolbar and axis crowding
signals_requiring_follow_up.next_experiment: After mobile routing is fixed, test actual mobile route for toolbar overlap, clipped price-axis labels and usable plot width.

signals_requiring_follow_up.title: Minute interval labels contain malformed text in the rendered dropdown DOM
signals_requiring_follow_up.next_experiment: Open the dropdown with a trusted click, capture a screenshot and verify the text visible to a user.

not_assessed.area: live quote liveness and update cadence
not_assessed.reason: The evidence run occurred during a UTC weekend; absence of live frames was deliberately not classified as a defect.
No direct or authenticated subscription was allowed in this public passive scope.
Requires explicit written authorization, isolated accounts and a separate scope.

rejected_false_positives.title: Generic observer labeled an aborted Google Analytics request as market-data failure
rejected_false_positives.reason: The failed URL was analytics.google.com, not a quote or candle dependency.

rejected_false_positives.title: First timeframe probe reported no new HLOC after a synthetic DOM click
rejected_false_positives.reason: The broad selector and untrusted event were invalid. A later visible trusted mouse click produced a clean D1-to-H1 transition.

next_authorized_experiments: During an open market session, measure page-ready to first quote, update cadence, stale timeout and market-closed behavior.
Interrupt and restore network locally, then verify reconnect without duplicate, regressing or out-of-order quote timestamps.
Switch symbols A-to-B and verify that a late A response cannot overwrite the selected B chart or quote.
Switch intervals rapidly within a bounded public scenario and verify late D1/H1 responses cannot overwrite the current selection.
Compare chart last value, quote tile and latest completed candle only when their timestamps and session semantics are aligned.
Validate timezone, holidays, session boundaries and absence of phantom weekend candles across several instrument classes.
With written authorization, test bid <= ask, last within daily high/low, percentage change versus previous close and order-book monotonicity.
